market_summary: Strong directional moves during New York Session. EURUSD and XAUUSD show sustained bearish pressure below Value Area and VWAP backed by negative CVD. US100 exhibits robust bullish expansion above VAH and upper ATR bands. GBPUSD consolidates inside its Value Area while BTCUSD faces resistance near session highs with diverging cumulative delta.

signals.rationale: Price is below_val (VAL 4032.34) and below POC (4043.60). CVD is BEARISH (-2.15) with negative slope. Trading in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4040.03) and EMA50 (4036.30), breaking below the lower ATR band (4009.68). Recent yellow RVOL spike confirmed strong selling pressure, though live price is hovering near Session Low (4000.54) causing potential short-term stretch. Sell on breakdown bias, but setup is extended near support.

Price is below_val (VAL 1.11034) and far below POC (1.11376). CVD is BEARISH (-15,536) with negative slope (-1154.51). Active NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trending firmly below VWAP (1.11298) and EMA50 (1.11280), hugging the lower ATR band (1.10943). Supported by clear earlier yellow RVOL spikes confirming trend expansion towards Session Low (1.10824). Direction aligns strongly with orderflow.

Price is inside VA (VAL 1.32661, VAH 1.33251) and hovering right near POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,562) with positive short-term slope (+3309.28). Active NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33092) and EMA50 (1.33104), testing the lower ATR band region after rebounding off Session Low (1.32661) with yellow RVOL spike. Mixed signals inside value area warrant a pause.
signals.level_event: rejection at Session Low with bounce

signals.rationale: Price is above_vah (VAH 28299.47) and far above POC (28263.55). CVD is BULLISH (+11.73) with positive slope (+3.42). Active NEW_YORK_SESSION. Strong uptrend riding above VWAP (28153.31) and EMA50 (28199.53), breaking above the upper ATR band (28438.94) towards Session High (28471.88). Absence of yellow RVOL is standard for Dukascopy US100. High momentum bullish structure.
signals.level_event: acceptance above VAH and testing Session High

signals.rationale: Price is above_vah (VAH 73920.85) and above POC (73650.62). CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06) with flat slope, showing divergence against price breakout. Active NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (73703.48) and EMA50 (73751.00), reaching upper ATR band (74413.17) but encountering resistance at S/R (74254.90) and Session High (74384.10) without strong RVOL volume confirmation. Caution advised.
